title: Update build.gradle for Java 25 & Spring Boot 4.0.x
description: Update Java version, Spring Boot plugin, and dependencies in build.gradle to target Java 25 and Spring Boot 4.0.x.
acceptance_criteria: build.gradle reflects Java 21 and Spring Boot 3.2.x

title: Update settings.gradle and gradle.properties
description: Ensure plugin repositories and JVM/toolchain settings are compatible with Java 25.
acceptance_criteria: settings.gradle and gradle.properties (if present) are updated

title: Update CI workflow to use Java 25
description: Modify .github/workflows/build.yml to use Java 25 for builds and tests.

title: Update application.properties for compatibility
description: Review and update src/main/resources/application.properties for any breaking property changes.

title: Refactor code for Spring Boot 3.x breaking changes
description: Update code to address removed/deprecated APIs, migrate javax.* to jakarta.*, and resolve other breaking changes.

title: Test and validate upgrade
description: Run all tests and validate application functionality locally and in CI.
preconditions: All code and config changes complete
